record.reason: The primary paper proposes training-time adaptation that teaches an LLM to answer easy scientific questions directly and invoke tools for harder ones, reducing unnecessary tool use while improving accuracy across six scientific benchmarks. It does not report inference latency, token, or compute savings, so its link to efficient reasoning is plausible but not established.
record.title: Adapting While Learning: Grounding LLMs for Scientific Problems with Tool Usage Adaptation
